text: You see Lyle.

text: So you're the water thief! You traitor!

text: I'm so glad that the ordeal is over. Thank you.

text: Hello, Lyle. How are you holding up?

text: We're doing all right here. But I hope that you find the water chip soon. Everybody's on edge and we don't have much time.

text: Wahnnnngh!

text: Not so good. Ever since I had one of my water rations stolen the other day, things have been going downhill. Everybody is getting scared and nobody knows what to do.

text: That's too bad. I hope things get better.

text: I'll take a look and see what I can do.

text: Yeah, I hope so too.

text: Thanks. I sure hope you can get to the bottom of this. And please hurry and find a new water chip. This craziness wouldn't have happened at all if we had a working chip!

text: Thanks for catching that thief. You're doing a good job. But please hurry and find the chip, or it won't matter!

text: How could you betray us like this? Leave me alone!

text: 你看见莱尔。

text: 因此你就是偷水贼！你是叛徒！

text: 我非常高兴严酷的考验结束了。谢谢你。

text: 嗨，

text: 嗨，莱尔。你进展如何？

text: 我们这里还好。但是我希望你能很快找到净水芯片。每个人都在生死边缘上，我们快没时间了。

text: 太坏了。我希望事情会好起来。

text: 我去看看，也许能帮上忙。

text: 是的，我也这么希望。

text: 谢谢你逮到了那个小偷。你做了一件好事。但是请赶快去找净水芯片，否则就太晚了！
